blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu-based World Boxing Organization (WBO) Asia-Pacific super bantamweight champion Gabriel Santisima will return to Japan for a challenging title defense against hometown fighter Kaitao Yamasaki on December 6 in Osaka. Sanman Boxing officially announced the upcoming bout on its social media page. The 22-year-old Santisima made a major breakthrough in the […]...
